**Goal.** Simulate from `mod2` on the real design (site-to-site variance, nothing spatial), fit the same two models as stage 1, and see what the spatial-residual checks say when we *know* there's no spatial pattern. This is the "no space" reference for stage 4.

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("../sim/_load.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(sf)
library(spdep)

# Truth, design and locations saved by stage 1 (render stage 1 first)
stage1 <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "stage1.rds"))
stage1$truth
```

`sim_glmm()` in `sim/sim_glmm.R`: fresh a_j ~ N(0, σ²) for the 24 locations on every call, η = Xβ + a[location], NB1 counts. σ is an argument so the ramp can override it.
